column5: Operation Phase, Turn 4, a trivial command

column4: ランス城
column5: Rance Castle

column4: このような事をしていてはラチがあかん
column5: Doing things like this won't get us anywhere.

column4: 魔人ケイブリスか、敵のボスと一騎打ちで勝負を決める
column5: Fiend Kayblis, I will settle this with a one-on-one duel against the enemy boss.

column4: 人類の１番えらい俺様が相手になってやる。がははは
column5: I, the greatest of humanity, will be your opponent. Gahaha!

column4: 御触れをだす
column5: Issue an official notice

column4: 街中に看板、果たし状・・
column5: Posting challenge signs all over town...

column4: そんなの来る訳が・・　いえ、現れました。
column5: There's no way they would come... No, they actually appeared.

column4: よし、行くぞ・・
column5: Alright, let's go...

column4: 広場に行くと、ランスを待っていたのは　自称勇者と名乗る男
column5: When I went to the plaza, the one waiting for Rance was a man who called himself a hero.

column4: 自信過剰、俺はケイブリスとやらではないが、世界最強の自負がある
column5: Overconfident, he said: I'm not Kayblis or whatever, but I pride myself as the strongest in the world.

column4: 人類の支配者ランス、お前を倒して俺が人類を指揮してやる
column5: Rance, ruler of humanity, I'll defeat you and lead humanity myself.

column4: ばーんと簡単にランスに倒される
column5: Boom! He was easily defeated by Rance.

column4: えーい、勘違いやろうめ
column5: Hey, you're mistaken, fool!

column4: 数日立ったが・・当然ケイブリスはこなかった
column5: Several days passed... but naturally, Kayblis did not come.

column4: うむ、この方法は無理だったか
column5: Hmm, this method did not work after all.

column4: あれから　俺が魔人ケイブリスだと着ぐるみ着て現れた馬鹿とか、
column5: Since then, idiots who wore a costume pretending to be Fiend Kayblis appeared,

column4: ランス様を倒して名を上げようとしたい人だけでしたね。
column5: but only people who wanted to make a name by defeating Lord Rance.

column4: サテラ、それで奴が現れるようだったら解決していたらホーネット様は苦労していない
column5: Satella, if that guy had actually appeared, Hornet-sama wouldn't have had such trouble.

column4: 奴は　最強の弱虫なのだ、勝負などに現れる訳はない
column5: He is the strongest coward; there's no way he'd show up for a fight.
